facts.fact: The eServices portal offers online applications for permits and clearances from the revenue authorities, the Bureau of Standards accreditation permit, TIN registration on eTax and business registration, with payment online and permit delivered as PDF.

The portal describes a single username and password giving access to services of several agencies (revenue authorities, Bureau of Standards, business registration), as a single account for all government to citizen services.
